<div style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left"><b>SECTION 5 </b>&#8211;<b> CORPORATE GOVERNANCE AND MANAGEMENT</b></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 5.07.</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b>Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders</b></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Results of the Annual Meeting of Stockholders</span></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">An Annual Meeting of Stockholders (the &#8220;<b>Meeting</b>&#8221;) of the Company was held on November 10, 2026 to approve the agenda items described below.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Proxies for the Meeting were solicited pursuant to Regulation&#160;14A under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and there was no solicitation in opposition to the Company&#8217;s solicitation.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">A total of <span style="text-decoration: underline;">56,301,165</span> shares (61.58% of the 91,422,569 issued and outstanding shares of the Company entitled to vote as of the September 14, 2026 record date for the Meeting) were present in person or by proxy, constituted a quorum for the transaction of business and were voted at the Meeting. The agenda items submitted at the Meeting were passed as described below. Percentages indicated below reflect the percentage of the total number of shares voted at the Meeting with respect to that agenda item.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">There were 6,238,115 broker non-votes with respect to this agenda item. Broker non-votes and abstentions were counted for purposes of determining the presence or absence of a quorum. Abstentions were deemed to be &#8220;votes cast&#8221; and had the same effect as a vote against this agenda item. Broker non-votes were not deemed to be &#8220;votes cast&#8221;, and therefore had no effect on the vote with respect to this proposal.</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;"><b>SECTION 7 </b>&#8211;<b> REGULATION FD</b></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Item 7.01</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b>Regulation FD Disclosure</b></div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">On November 10, 2026 the Company issued a news release to announce the results of the Meeting. The Meeting was held on November 10, 2026 in Vancouver, British Columbia. All resolutions put forward at the meeting were approved by shareholders. A total of 56,301,165 common shares, representing 61.58% of the votes attached to all outstanding shares as at the record date of the meeting, were represented at the Meeting. The following individuals were elected, by ballot, as directors of the Company: Anton J. Drescher, Fabrice Helliker, Maurice Loverso, Rowland Perkins, Tom Perovic, and Ron Wages.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">Note: Routine US broker-vote shares voted without beneficial owner instructions are only eligible to vote for the appointment of auditors. Accordingly, 6,238,114 common shares were represented by proxy, but not voted.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">By a resolution unanimously passed, Davidson &amp; Company LLP, Chartered Professional Accountants, were appointed as the auditors for the Company for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 and, in accordance with the Articles of the Company, the directors were authorized to fix the auditors remuneration.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">By a resolution, the shareholders unanimously ratified and approved the continuation of the Company&#8217;s Omnibus Equity Incentive Compensation Plan.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">By a resolution, the shareholders unanimously ratified and approved the amendment to the Company&#8217;s Articles of Incorporation to effect a reverse stock split of the Company&#8217;s outstanding shares of common stock at a ratio between 1-for-2 and 1-for-10, with such ratio, implementation and timing of the reverse stock split to be determined at the discretion of the board of directors.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">By a resolution, the Company&#8217;s executive compensation was approved.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">By a resolution, the frequency of stockholder votes on the Company&#8217;s executive compensation was approved to be presented to the stockholders annually.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>

<div style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;">The detailed &#8220;Report of Voting Results&#8221; on all resolutions for the Company&#8217;s Meeting is available on the Company&#8217;s website, in the Company&#8217;s Current Report on Form 8-K as filed with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission available under the Company&#8217;s profile on EDGAR or upon request by contacting the Company&#8217;s Corporate Secretary at (604) 685-1017.</div>

<div style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</div>
